title: Feel-Good Productivity: How to Do More of What Matters to You
author: Ali Abdaal
engineRationale: Abdaal's core argument is that productivity isn't about disciplined suffering, but emotional state — play, power, people, and energy friction. The relatable subject is the everyday knowledge worker / student paralyzed at their laptop, procrastinating, or burning out at their desk. This internal, psychological, and habit-driven experience is the exact sweet spot for Antidote's flat-vector Everyman rig and kinetic typography.
